scope: The fullscreen installer restores the live Dock opacity on Plasma 6.7.4 when the scripting setter leaves it adaptive.

checks.command: Golden Gate graphical installation on Debian Plasma 6.7.4 Wayland with two QEMU outputs, dark appearance, auto-hide and layout reset. The rebuilt Dock stayed adaptive through the scripting setter. After the targeted setting write and Plasma restart, the same live panel reported translucent, the glass renderer was ready, and the wizard reached done with no fullscreen overlay.
Inspected the actual Dock on red and blue maximized backdrops. Validated installed asset fingerprints and decoded 6355 light and 6355 dark icon PNGs.
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_layout_step.py (29 passed), including rejected live verification after restoration.

coverage_limits: Golden Gate exercised the shared backend on virtual graphics. Firefox integration was skipped because this guest lacked a profile. Physical GPUs and other display servers were outside this run.
